affected_component: host_guided.public_fixture_digest + _build_workspace_tool_prompt 'WHAT ACCEPTANCE COMPARES' section + runner prompt wiring (build_host_prompt public_fixture_digest kwarg)
invariant: The workspace-tool-v1 statement says up front what the golden gate compares (output_dir vs expected tree byte-for-byte, application file and README included) and carries a digest computed only from the public fixtures the Agent may read anyway: example count and layout, the runtime paths the Harness seals (not the Agent's to write), the expected files identical across every public example (input-independent, reproducible by a byte-exact copy) and the files that vary with the input, plus the note that copied inputs may be normalised. The digest carries paths and classes, never file bytes; tasks without public fixtures render no digest; other prompt profiles are untouched. A gate that kills on bytes must teach what it compares before the first model call.
